newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic named "best idea".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic named "best idea".

text.p: -- Prudential Securities re-named Olympic Steel Inc as its "single best idea" with a 12-month price target of $52 a share.
-- Prudential sees Olympic as having "terrific" earnings growth. The firm expects Olympic to earn $0.28 a share in the fourth quarter and $2.10 a share in 1997.
-- Prudential also said Olympic benefits from a solid financial position and strong management.
-- Prudential said Olympic's share are "considerably undervalued."
-- Olympic gained 2-11/16 to 26-1/16 in afternoon trading.
